hero.asylum-town.a_alach.biography: As a mental strengthed warrior, Alach is cruel and merciless to any opposites. He never takes off his mental mask since he had joined the Asylum.
hero.asylum-town.a_alach.name: Alach
hero.asylum-town.a_alach.specialty.descr: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offence skill percentage.
hero.asylum-town.a_alach.specialty.name: Offence
hero.asylum-town.b_pauline.biography: Pauline's long purplr hair and a pair of amethyst eyes are the symbol of a noble girl. However, Pauline prefer to learning archery instead of being a nobility. The amethyst girl used to live in Bracada, she started to go to the enigma place and search for her own livelihood after she had felt psychic power.
hero.asylum-town.b_pauline.name: Pauline
hero.asylum-town.b_pauline.specialty.des: Increases Speed of any Shadow Hunters or Phantom Hunters by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.asylum-town.c_harker.biography: Harker used to be a servant of a demon lord. He always be treated mercilessly by his master. Since he had learned the magic of mental domination, finally he controlled his master, and then he makes the cruel demon into his mental cage perpetually.
hero.asylum-town.c_harker.name: Harker
hero.asylum-town.c_harker.specialty.desc: Increases Speed of any Dark Squires or Dark Guards by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
hero.asylum-town.c_harker.specialty.name: Dark Squires
hero.asylum-town.d_sisElisa.biography: As a sacred priest, Sister Elisa used to be a companion of King Roland. After the battle of Ironfist, she started to show her interest in dark power. Now she no longer follows the King Roland and persue a new identification, as an assassin.
hero.asylum-town.d_sisElisa.name: Sister Elisa
hero.asylum-town.d_sisElisa.specialty.de: Increases Speed of any Wind Dancers or Shadow Dancers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.asylum-town.e_renner.biography: No one knows how a necromancer came to the Asylum, but undead hero is also acceptable here. Renner might be a sepctre who is abandoned by Deyja, he must have the purpose while he chosed the Asylum.
hero.asylum-town.e_renner.name: Renner
hero.asylum-town.e_renner.specialty.desc: Increases Speed of any Apparitions or Will-o'-the-Wisps by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.asylum-town.e_renner.specialty.name: Apparitions
hero.asylum-town.f_judith.biography: Before he joined the Asylum, Judith is a good leader for crusaders in Erathia. He decided to persure the dark power since he had battled with vampires. To become a dark knight might be his pursuance.
hero.asylum-town.f_judith.name: Judith
hero.asylum-town.f_judith.specialty.desc: Increases Speed of any Spirit Crusaders or Soul Crusaders by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.asylum-town.f_judith.specialty.name: Spirit Crusaders
hero.asylum-town.g_stacia.biography: Stacia used to hate unicorns, even feared them since she was a child. She left Vori and sailed across the ocean, to find a place without unicorns. While a storm destoryed her ship, she had to settle down in a mystical island. In this island, she found the nightmares can become their companion. Now she does not fear unicorns any longer.
hero.asylum-town.g_stacia.name: Stacia
hero.asylum-town.g_stacia.specialty.desc: Increases Speed of any Nightmares or Shadowmares by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.asylum-town.g_stacia.specialty.name: Nightmares
hero.asylum-town.h_karth.biography: Karth sees conspiracies everywhere and is too tactless to keep them to himself. Once he accused Queen Catherine of being a spy.  He was immediately transferred to a border town, and then he learned the power of psychic spells, he supposes that he can caught anyone's heart.
hero.asylum-town.h_karth.name: Karth
hero.asylum-town.h_karth.specialty.descr: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
hero.asylum-town.h_karth.specialty.name: Logistics
hero.asylum-town.i_kaspar.biography: Kaspar spent several years in an Erathian prison for impersonating a noble and accumulating more than one hundred thousand gold in debt.  While in the dungeons, however, he learned magic from an old, nameless sorcerer, and then he was released by the guard who had been controlled by psychic magic.
hero.asylum-town.i_kaspar.name: Kaspar
hero.asylum-town.i_kaspar.specialty.desc: Casts Berserk with expert effects but not expert range.
hero.asylum-town.i_kaspar.specialty.name: Berserk
hero.asylum-town.j_mog.biography: Mog spent many year to research the psychic power. As an experiment, he controlled Dainwin, a knight in Enroth. Now he comes to a new land for increasing his power, and realizes his amibition.
hero.asylum-town.j_mog.name: Mog
hero.asylum-town.j_mog.specialty.descrip: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill percentage.
hero.asylum-town.j_mog.specialty.name: Intelligence
hero.asylum-town.k_viola.biography: Viola might be beautiful and charming, but no one dares to be a persuer of her. Almost anyone knows she has the ability of hypnotize, her voice might be a powerful weapon if someone becomes her opposite.
hero.asylum-town.k_viola.name: Viola
hero.asylum-town.k_viola.specialty.descr: Casts Hypnotize with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units.)
hero.asylum-town.k_viola.specialty.name: Hypnotize
hero.asylum-town.l_brigid.biography: Brid used to be a magic apprentice in Bracada, but he was deported because he wanted to learn dark magic. He could never quit for his interest although he cannot study in college any more.
hero.asylum-town.l_brigid.name: Brid
hero.asylum-town.l_brigid.specialty.desc: Casts Blind with expert effects but not expert range.
hero.asylum-town.l_brigid.specialty.name: Blind
hero.asylum-town.m_mona.biography: Mona had lived in Kreegan for many years, but she lost her confidence for demons. She decided to leave there and find a new place to realize her own ambition.
hero.asylum-town.m_mona.name: Mona
hero.asylum-town.m_mona.specialty.descri: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.asylum-town.m_mona.specialty.name: Sorcery
hero.asylum-town.n_jezebel.biography: Since she was a child, jezebel lived in a horde of barbarians in Enroth, but she did not want to live with the rude barbarians. After the Ironfist War, Jezebel left there for searching a beatiful world which she expected.
hero.asylum-town.n_jezebel.name: Jezebel
hero.asylum-town.n_jezebel.specialty.des: Increases kingdom's gem production by 1 per day.
hero.asylum-town.o_margareta.biography: Margareta is a famous sorceress, but less people know her background. Many individuals like talking with her. However, they never remember what they talk with Margareta, because all of their memories in this moment were deleted by the powerful sorceress.
hero.asylum-town.o_margareta.name: Margareta
hero.asylum-town.o_margareta.specialty.d: Casts Forgetfulness with expert effects but not expert range.
hero.asylum-town.p_Lynn.biography: Lynn has a sorrow experience since she left her family in a very young age. She found the interest in music and create many melodies with sadness. However, she still hope her sister Renata can meet her again, even if she is not confirmed whether her sister is still alive.
hero.asylum-town.p_Lynn.name: Lynn
hero.asylum-town.p_Lynn.specialty.descri: Casts Sorrow with expert effects but not expert range.
hero.asylum-town.p_Lynn.specialty.name: Sorrow
